brief: introduce the main character of my short film: an old fisherwoman who knows the sea
concept: We meet her hands before her face, and the sea before her hands.
plan_outline: 0. Character reference first: a neutral portrait of the woman (about seventy, silver hair in a knot, a faded blue sari, a scar on her chin), kept in NeuralCore
1. EWS · eye · static · rocky shore at dawn, grey sea · a tiny figure walking along the waterline (5 s)
2. ECU · eye · static · same shore · weathered hands untangling a net, simple slow movement (4 s)
3. MCU · eye · push in · same shore · her face as she looks at the horizon and reads the sky (6 s)
4. WS · low · static · same shore · she pushes the boat into the surf alone (5 s)
why: A character intro reveals in layers: world → work → face → action; the face is earned.
Three fixed anchors (silver knot, faded blue sari, chin scar) and a reference picture keep her the same in every shot.
The hands shot keeps one slow, simple action so the model does not break the fingers.
